rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n. Start x at 4; repeat n times: double x and add 6. Print x.
rows.target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER x=4.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<n, i++) { x=x*2+6. }
DISPLAYNL(x).

rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n; sum the cubes of odd i from 1 through n, then subtract 6.
rows.target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total = 0.
NUMBER cube = 0.
LOOP (NUMBER i = 1 TILL i <= n, i++) { cube = i * i * i. IF (i % 2 != 0) { total += cube. } }
DISPLAYNL(total - 6).

rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n. Multiply the values 5+i for i from 0 up to but not including n; print the product minus n.

rows.prompt: Read text; lowercase it and print LONG1 if length is at least 5, else the lowercase text.
rows.target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE text.
INPUT(text).
SENTENCE low=strings.LOWER(text).
IF (strings.LENGTH(low)>=5) { DISPLAYNL("LONG1"). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL(low). }
